cases.purpose: getstr shows the prompt, applies backspace and prints the entered line
cases.script: tui init; tui getstr -y 0 -x 0 'Name: ' > answer; tui end
cases.oracle: tui help text: state persists from init to end; lines/cols report the terminal size; move/addstr use Y X screen coordinates (curses convention, origin 0,0); getkey prints a token (UP/.../TAB/... or the literal char) with rc 0 key, 2 timeout; getstr prints the entered line; end restores the terminal.

cases.purpose: A sequence split across writes inside the grace interval still decodes; a lone ESC followed by a pause does not absorb the next key
cases.script: bashtermraw raw; kgetch read > k1; kgetch read > esc; kgetch read > k2; kgetch read > k3; bashtermraw cooked
cases.oracle: kgetch help text and published key API: ESC grace is 50 ms; read prints 'NAME CODE' (key_up 257, key_down 258, key_f1 272, char N) for ECMA-48/xterm input sequences.
